dogecoin.text: I bought dogecoin back in February for 1 cent. It was 13% of my portfolio. I haven’t bought any more since and after this week it represents 60% of my portfolio.  800% gains.

Don’t let the traditional investors that are afraid of crypto scare you away from Dogecoin. They don’t understand it so they don’t want you to invest in it. But #dogeday is here and if you’re in you know the roller coaster ride we are about to go on. See you on the moon
